predecessors.name: Maukhari dynasty
predecessors.text: Kanyakubja (Kannauj), the Maukhari seat that Harsha 'eventually made ... his capital'

successors.name: Arunasva Kannauj
successors.text: the Harsha page's successor 'Arunāsva (as King of Kannauj)', the usurper who attacked Wang Xuance's party in 648

ledger.x: 606: Bhaskaravarman of Kamarupa offers his alliance.
606: the Later Guptas of Magadha rule as Harsha's vassals.
Nov 618: Harsha marches to the Narmada.
Feb 619: Pulakeshin II wins on the Narmada.
626: the court moves from Thanesar to Kanyakubja (Kannauj).

c. 640: Valabhi (the Maitrakas) under Harsha. Pushyabhuti page: 'Overlordship was accepted by the king of Vallabhi (west)', undated; 640 is the year the maitraka-dynasty dossier reads from the Maitraka page ('mid-seventh century'), not a page opened here.
647: Valabhi and Kamarupa are free again.
647: Bhaskaravarman's alliance ends with Harsha's death; Kamarupa's reign ran to c.
647: the Later Guptas are independent again.
647: Harsha dies without an heir and the empire ends.

wars.name: Harsha's campaign against Shashanka of Gauda
wars.outcome: Inconclusive: Harsha 'vowed to destroy the Gauda king', allied with Bhaskar Varman and 'forced Shashanka to retreat', but the Harsha page says the campaign 'remained inconclusive'.

wars.name: Harsha-Pulakeshin II war on the Narmada
wars.outcome: Pulakeshin II repelled Harsha; the Narmada became the frontier between the Chalukya and Harsha's empires.

certainty.note: Every frontier is approximate: the pages give regions (north and north-west India, the Narmada in the south, Kamarupa in the east), never a surveyed line.
